title: Numerical Semiampleness of Nef Adjoint Divisors
summary: We prove the Generalised Abundance Conjecture: if $`(X,B)`$ is a projective klt ℚ-pair over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, $`K_X+B`$ is pseudo-effective, M is a nef ℚ-Cartier divisor on X , and $`K_X+B+M`$ is nef, then $`K_X+B+M`$ is numerically equivalent to a semiample ℚ-Cartier divisor on X .
family_title: Numerical semiampleness and generalized minimal models

review.reason: Proves the Generalised Abundance Conjecture for klt pairs via numerical semiampleness.
